[EN] Hello. I'm Hasmina, from the Mysterium.
[ES] Hola. Soy Hasmina, del Mysterium.

[EN] The Argons...they've destroyed everything.
[ES] Los Argons... lo han destruido todo.

[EN] Everything...even my life.
[ES] Todo... incluso mi vida.

[EN] I find myself lucky that I have a chance to wipe out those Argons.
[ES] Me considero afortunado de tener la oportunidad de aniquilar a esos Argons.
